findings.text: The page says "five tabs" and then shows six buttons (AI … Admin, Element): ext/drawer/page.js:710 (diff.patch:710) and readme.md:735 both say five, while tabs.js:932 lists six. In sheet.png at 3440px, Element even wraps onto a row of its own under the other five, which makes it look like it belongs to something else. Say "six tabs", or say Element is the tab that opens when you select something.

select.js:801 listens for `pointerleave` on `document`, but that event does not bubble and never fires on the document. So when the pointer leaves the window, the last hovered paragraph stays lit. Listen for `pointerout` with `relatedTarget === null`, or for `mouseleave` on `document.documentElement`.

The Element tab and click-to-select (select.js, tabs/element.js) are not in requirements.md. They come from minion 2's brief (owner-words-4). They are in the owner's spirit, but they are extra surface that this review was not asked to judge.

The requirement says the card's composer "moves in". Instead it is imported (tabs/ai.js:1071), and the card keeps its own footer composer, so a card page now has two composers once the drawer is open. That matches the minion brief, but check that the owner meant "reuse" and not "relocate".

With the drawer open on AI 2, any click on a card or a paragraph also selects it and jumps the drawer to the Element tab (select.js:845 `tabs.open("element")`). That can pull the reader off the AI or Sessions tab they were using. It may be better to only highlight the element and let the reader switch tabs themselves.

The ☰ is added on every page with no dev check (app.js:20), so the static production site also gets it. There, the AI tab can only say "No page assistant yet", and Settings and Admin show dev-server tools. The http:// `PAGE_AI` call (tabs/ai.js:1094) would also be blocked as mixed content on an https site.
In tabs/ai.js:1194, the hint "Ask anything about this page…" stays under the conversation after the first message has been sent. Remove it on the first turn.

The Dictation tab only works once the dictation playground is merged. Until then it shows a one-line message and logs a 404 (tabs/dictation.js:1254). Merge the playground first, or land them together.

The proof pngs sit under `ai/**/shots/`, which .gitignore excludes (m2/task.jsonl:221). So every shot link in m1/proof.md and m2/proof.md breaks once the worktree is gone. Only doc/tabs.png and doc/select.png survive.
The fence asked for a check of list_agents and the AI 2 card before the composer was edited. m1/task.jsonl does not record that check, even though ai2/compose.js was edited (diff.patch:247).

sheet.png only shows the drawer page with the drawer shut, so this review could not judge how the open drawer uses its space. The ☰ sits alone in the far top-right corner: fine at 1280, but at 3440 it is about 2000px from the page title, where it is easy to miss. The page is 61–84% empty at every width, which comes from the Doc sheet, not from this work.

Simpler, and fine as it is: the lazy one-file-per-tab model (tabs.js:926) and `drawer.filled_by()` are small, clear seams. The two-line guard in ext/layout/panel.js:1469, outside the fence, is a real fix and is logged.
